ENTRY.NAME: Iron Fusion Vault (Male)
ENTRY.DESCRIPTION: Hidden in a top secret location, this Vault is filled with a collection of new suits from Iron Fusion, each with their own individual mechanics. The Iron Fusion Vault holds the secrets to metering out swift justice in PlayStation®Home. Upon entering the Iron Fusion Vault, the owner will be awarded Mechjet – Epic plus four special suits: Panthabot – Bhaltair, Barrin Mech Suit, Mechjet – Magnor and Mechsuit Pilot – Diablo.
